description: This file defines functions and types for handling system command execution, including command formatting, validation, and resolution, with focus on shell command parsing and inline command detection.

methods.name: formatExecCommand
methods.description: Formats an array of command arguments into a single string, adding quotes where necessary.

methods.name: extractShellCommandFromArgv
methods.description: Extracts the shell command from an argument vector using imported resolution logic.

methods.name: buildSystemRunCommandDisplay
methods.description: Builds a display object summarizing the command, including shell payload, formatted command text, and preview text.

methods.name: validateSystemRunCommandConsistency
methods.description: Validates that the raw command string matches the inferred command text and preview, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: resolveSystemRunCommand
methods.description: Resolves a system command from provided command array or raw command, returning detailed resolution info.

methods.name: resolveSystemRunCommandRequest
methods.description: Similar to resolveSystemRunCommand but with different mode, used for request handling.
